target: Gersborg-Andreasen (2011), casting parameterization; exact formulation differs.

checks.input_origin: own controlled bitmap, row 0 at physical y=0
checks.adjoint_scope: ordinary backward on a separate smooth 0.2-to-0.8 field; not a certificate at binary switches or for backward_volume overrides

limitations: The cited paper uses a Heaviside parameterization. This smooth running-minimum variant is not a direct reproduction; its output is only approximately monotone and does not model a full mould. The GUI run draws along +x on the MBB: top and bottom flanges taper towards the support around one grey web plateau (greyness 0.54), which reads as a thinner web; drawn along +y the top load forces grey full-height columns.
